## Implementation Complete

I've implemented a keyboard-triggered command palette for the application with the following features:

### What was created:

**CommandPalette Component** (`frontend/src/components/CommandPalette/CommandPalette.tsx`):
- Listens for **Ctrl+K** (Windows/Linux) or **Cmd+K** (Mac) to toggle the palette
- Opens a dialog with a search input and navigation options
- Shows filtered command list as user types
- Navigates to selected destination using TanStack Router
- Includes keyboard shortcuts: **Escape** to close, **Enter** to select

### Features:
- **Dashboard** - Navigate to home page (/)
- **Items** - Navigate to items page (/items)
- **Settings** - Navigate to user settings (/settings)
- **Admin** - Navigate to admin panel (/admin) *only for superusers*
- Real-time search/filter of commands by title
- "No commands found" message when search matches nothing
- Auto-focuses search input when palette opens
- Only available to logged-in users (integrated into _layout component)

### Integration:
- Added CommandPalette component to the `/_layout` route, making it available on all protected pages
- Uses existing UI components (Dialog, Input) for consistency
- Respects user role via auth hook for superuser-only Admin option
